integrity: All proofs and numerical checks are supplied; numerical tests do not establish infinite-law claims. Established original-model balance identities and classical Hermite interpolation are credited. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
limitations: Stationary homogeneous perfect-protection SIRVS renewal model with natural-immunity support and two moments; no proof of time-dependent attraction, stochastic finite-population behavior, or broader optimality in other epidemic mechanisms. Two-point endpoint attainment uses arbitrary probability laws and may only be limiting for PDE density-only restrictions.
title: Sharp two-moment endemic-incidence envelopes under a fixed realized vaccine-dose budget
